newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTORCYCLING-JAPANESE CELEBRATES WIN WITH UNINTENTIONAL INSULT.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-JAPANESE CELEBRATES WIN WITH UNINTENTIONAL INSULT.

text.p: Japanese rider Tomomi Manako had some explaining to do after stunning local fans by celebrating his win in the 125cc Grand Prix of Catalonia with what appeared to be a traditional Latin insult.
Manako repeatedly grasped one arm at the elbow with the other hand and raised an outstretched finger.
"I didn't mean that, I didn't know what it meant. I was saying `number one'," said Manako after the victory, his first in the category.
